messages:
maya: Quick sync: consolidating Optimize toolkit changes into one doc PR. main goals: concise batching examples, KV-prefetch note, and a minimal quant profile sample. PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/518
samir: i'll add compact SDK snippets for JS + Py. plan: show batch API + one caveat about measuring tail latency.
elaine: i'll run the quant regressions on the eval harness and add a short "when to prefer 8-bit vs 4-bit" box. found some prompt classes sensitive to 4-bit.
ryan: linkcheck flagged /optimize/heuristics anchor. i'll either add redirects or update anchors in the heuristics page.
maya: keep the examples tiny. suggested JS snippet: ```js
await client.generate({ model: 'redwood/serve-1', input: prompts, batch_size: 8, cache_policy: 'prefix' })
```
samir: Python snippet: ```py
resp = client.generate(model='redwood/serve-1', input=prompts, batch_size=8)
```
samir: question: include streaming+batching note? could add one short line.
devx: yes — add: "Streaming supports batching but may increase flushes per connection; use batching for bulk offline jobs." and link to SDK streaming docs.
elaine: quant YAML to include:
```yaml
quant_profile: balanced
bits: 4
fallback_fp16: true
recommended_seq_len: 512
```
elaine: tests: 4-bit gives ~1.9x throughput in batch workloads locally, but drop in QA fidelity on persona prompts. i'll add a 2-sentence heuristic.
maya: also add a tiny "Dedicated migration" checklist: 1) confirm pinned variant accepts quant_profile, 2) canary with 5k requests, 3) monitor p95 + token-cost. one-liner only.
ryan: i'll review links + run linter after snippets land. aiming to merge Friday.
maya: timeline noted. assign owners in PR description and i'll do the final squash & merge. :rocket:
